text.en:
The PCSO is hereby directed to set aside the amount of
P420,585,000.00, corresponding to fifty percent (50%) of the remainder of the standby
fund under Section 4 of EO No. 201, to cover the financial requirements for the treatment,
containment, prevention and management of COVID-19 cases in the country. The other
50% shall continue to cover the funding necessary to respond to future cases of SARS in
the Philippines.
The IATF-MEID, through the DOH, shall coordinate with the PCSO relative to the
release of the abovementioned funds, subject to applicable budgeting, accounting and
auditing laws, rules and regulations.

Except for the foregoing amendment, all other provisions of EO No.
201 shall remain in full force and effect.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 14th day of
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand Twenty.
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary ^
REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES
